newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP DOWNHILL WINNER ZELENSKAYA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WORLD CUP DOWNHILL WINNER ZELENSKAYA.

text.p: profile of the winner of a women's World Cup downhill on
World Cup wins: 2. Downhills - Laax (97), Narvik (96)
Other feats: Has competed in four world championships and two
Olympics but has never finished higher than eighth. Hobbies
include figure skating and cross-country skiing.
Started skiing when five after parents enrolled her in sports
school to help improve her health. Lives in Austria during the
World Cup season but returns to Russia during the summer and
skis on snow-covered volcano near her home in Petrapavlovsk.
